:::{#thm-poisson-properties}
#### Mean and variance of the Poisson distribution

If $X \sim \Pois(\mean)$, then:

* $\Expp[X] = \mean$
* $\Varr(X) = \mean$

:::

::: proof

**Mean.**

$$
\ba
\Expp[X]
&= \sum_{x=0}^\infty x \cdot \P(X=x) && (\text{definition of expected value}) \\
&= 0 \cdot \P(X=0) + \sumto{x}{\infty} x \cdot \P(X=x) && (\text{separate } x=0 \text{ term}) \\
&= \sumto{x}{\infty} x \cdot \frac{\mean^x e^{-\mean}}{x!} && (\text{substitute Poisson PMF}) \\
&= \sumto{x}{\infty} x \cdot \frac{\mean^x e^{-\mean}}{x \cdot (x-1)!} && (\text{definition of factorial } x!) \\
&= \sumto{x}{\infty} \frac{\mean^x e^{-\mean}}{(x-1)!} && (\text{cancel factor of } x) \\
&= \mean \cdot \sumto{x}{\infty} \frac{\mean^{x-1} e^{-\mean}}{(x-1)!} && (\text{factor out one power of } \mean) \\
&= \mean \cdot \sum_{y=0}^\infty \frac{\mean^y e^{-\mean}}{y!} && (\text{change index variable } y \eqdef x-1) \\
&= \mean \cdot 1 && (\text{PMF sums to 1 over state space}) \\
&= \mean && (\text{simplify})
\ea
$$

**Variance.**
The same steps, canceling two factors instead of one, give $\E{X(X-1)}$:

$$
\ba
\E{X(X-1)}
&= \sum_{x=2}^\infty x(x-1) \cdot \frac{\mean^x e^{-\mean}}{x!} && (\text{LOTUS; the } x = 0, 1 \text{ terms are } 0) \\
&= \sum_{x=2}^\infty \frac{\mean^x e^{-\mean}}{(x-2)!} && (\text{cancel } x(x-1) \text{ against } x!) \\
&= \mean^2 \cdot \sum_{y=0}^\infty \frac{\mean^y e^{-\mean}}{y!} && (\text{factor out } \mean^2 \text{; } y \eqdef x - 2) \\
&= \mean^2 && (\text{PMF sums to 1})
\ea
$$

Then, by the [simplified expression for variance](variance-covariance.qmd#thm-variance)
and [linearity of expectation](expectation.qmd#thm-linearity-expectation):

$$
\ba
\Varr(X)
&= \E{X^2} - \sqf{\E{X}} && (\text{simplified expression for variance}) \\
&= \E{X(X-1)} + \E{X} - \sqf{\E{X}} && (X^2 = X(X-1) + X \text{; linearity}) \\
&= \mean^2 + \mean - \mean^2 && (\text{substitute}) \\
&= \mean && (\text{simplify})
\ea
$$

See also <https://statproofbook.github.io/P/poiss-mean>
and <https://statproofbook.github.io/P/poiss-var>.

:::
